caption:
What you say and what you mean are often two different things. Your team can only hear the first one.

Which one is yours?

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #feedback

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “I don’t want to deal with this today.”

messages.name: You say
messages.text: “Let me know if you need anything.”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “I never told you what I expect.”

slides.headline: Say what you mean. <u>Kindly</u>.
slides.sub: Your team can only act on the words you actually said.
